'''CH-1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that was active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. CH-1 was granted unique self-improvement programming by [[CH-1's creator|its creator]] and, seeking to continually modify and upgrade itself, the droid turned to [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] in order to raise funds. After gaining membership of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], the droid took on various bounty hunting assignments, and after the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] placed a bounty on the rogue [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] bounty hunter [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], CH-1 journeyed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to take on the assignment. Working alongside several other Pyke-affiliated agents, CH-1 and the other operatives tracked Leeachos through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], coming into conflict with the criminal cartel [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] along the way, and they eventually confronted Leeachos in an abandoned annex of the [[NovaCORE kelerium processing plant]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]].<ref name="Under a Black Sun" />
